name: Extract and compare
summary: Extract entities, compare lists, count frequency, key-value to JSON
author: friday-core
description: Turns messy text into tidy data. It holds 4 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. Extract entities: Emails, links, phone numbers, dates, amounts, hashtags, mentions and IPs found in text. List compare: What is only in the first list, only in the second, in both, and the union. Frequency count: How often each word or line appears, most common first. Key-value to JSON: Lines like name: Asha or port=8080 become typed JSON, dotted keys nest.
